info.adoration: Adoration Room (Mount Tabor) open daily 7am-11pm; closed on public holidays.
info.confession: Fridays 4pm-6pm and Saturdays 10am-12pm. There is currently no Confession before Mass; Confession at other times is by appointment with the Parish Office.
info.office_hours: Mon-Fri 9.30am-6.30pm; Sat-Sun 8.30am-1pm; closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Main and back gates are open daily 5am-11pm.
Parish library is open Sundays 8am-1pm and 4pm-5.30pm.

events.title: Sunday Fellowship breakfast
events.text: The Charismatic Prayer Group serves breakfast at JPII Hall this Sunday; love offerings are welcome.

events.title: The Jewish Roots of Advent (Session 1)
events.text: Two-session Bible study with SFXBAT based on the work of Dr Brant Pitre, at the Jeremiah room, Parish Centre Level 2. All are welcome; register at tinyurl.com/2026JewishRootsofAdvent.

events.title: Charismatic Prayer Meeting
events.text: Praise & Worship followed by Praying Over at the Hosea room, Parish Centre Level 2. All are welcome.

events.title: Exhibition on Pope Leo's catechesis on Lumen Gentium
events.text: Exhibition outside JPII Hall on Pope Leo's catecheses on the 16 documents of Vatican Council II; it ends on Sun 22 Nov.

events.title: The Jewish Roots of Advent (Session 2)
events.text: Second session of the SFXBAT Bible study at the Jeremiah room, Parish Centre Level 2. Register at tinyurl.com/2026JewishRootsofAdvent.

events.title: Caritas Singapore discussion night for young adults on AI
events.text: A night of discussion with pizza and ice-cream at Church of the Holy Spirit (Room 03-14); dinner starts at 7pm. Register at bit.ly/streetcreed.

events.title: Feast Day celebrations
events.text: Dinner at JPII Hall after the 5.30pm Feast Day Mass on Sat 28 Nov; breakfast after the 7am and 9am Masses and lunch after the 11am Mass on Sun 29 Nov. Potluck dishes (portioned for 4) are welcome at every Triduum Mass, dropped off by 7.30pm at JPII Hall.

events.title: Sunday Mass Readings Explained (SMRE)
events.text: Weekly Zoom study every Wednesday from 2 Dec, 8pm-9.45pm, with a short talk and small-group breakouts. Register at bit.ly/SFXBATSMRE.
